evidence: Carries Consensus label and modifies src/script/interpreter.cpp to implement BIP-347 OP_CAT validation rules in Tapscript.
rationale: Proposed soft forks and new consensus opcodes require rigorous review to ensure correctness if activated and to reach a project decision on consensus changes. Per validation guidance, 'Proposed soft forks (new opcodes, new consensus rules) are validation PRs. Their importance here is the importance of reaching a decision on them and of the code being correct if activated'.
